intro: Burhani College of Arts and Commerce and Starex University both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded BCom fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Burhani College of Arts and Commerce vs Starex University is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Starex University holds a NIRF 2023 rank of 68; Burhani College of Arts and Commerce has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: Burhani College of Arts and Commerce vs Starex University for BCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Burhani College of Arts and Commerce if its BCom programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose Starex University if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
Burhani College of Arts and Commerce lists B.Com Commerce. Starex University lists Bachelor of Commerce (Hons), Bachelor of Commerce(B.Com.).

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records do not hold a quotable BCom programme fee for Burhani College of Arts and Commerce on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.
On this page we record a programme total of ₹1.49 lakh for Starex University's Bachelor of Commerce (Hons).
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Burhani College of Arts and Commerce's 2023 figures are an average of ₹2 lakh and a highest of ₹5 lakh for B.Com Commerce. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
In our records, Starex University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for Bachelor of Commerce (Hons). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Burhani College of Arts and Commerce on this BCom page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Starex University on this BCom page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Delhi NCR. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Starex University is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Burhani College of Arts and Commerce can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
